tools.name: check_app
tools.description: Run a passive, read-only launch check on the public URL of a live app the user owns or is authorized to test (built with Replit, Lovable or Bolt). Checks: reachable and fast, SEO title/meta, robots/sitemap, security headers, open CORS, and a dev banner left in production. Only reads what any visitor

tools.name: get_fix_prompt
tools.description: Return a paste-ready prompt to fix a specific issue in the user's builder (Replit Agent, Lovable or Bolt). Use the issue id from check_app.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_app" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
